scenarios.summary: a live first launch: setup finds the local model server, tests it, saves, chat opens, and the first prompt is sent
scenarios.title: First launch of CLIO Coder: setup finds a local model and chat opens

steps.wait: Clio found a way to reach a model

steps.type: Explain how this repository builds and runs its tests. Identify the main entry points and suggest one verification task. Do not change files yet.

capture.label: First launch
capture.alt: Terminal recording of a first launch of CLIO Coder 0.8.0-rc.1 with no model configured: clio-coder starts setup, which finds a LiteLLM model server at http://127.0.0.1:4000 serving qwen3.8-27b. Choosing it sends one test message, answered in 0.4 s, and saves the settings. Chat opens with the model ready, the first prompt asks how the repository builds and runs its tests, and the recording ends as the agent starts reading the repository.
capture.caption: First launch: setup finds a local model server, tests it, and saves it; chat opens and the first prompt is sent. The recording covers setup through the first prompt.

scenarios.summary: a live first task: the model finds the absolute-zero bug, fixes it, and runs the declared test check
scenarios.title: A first task in CLIO Coder: fix a failing test and verify

steps.type: The absolute-zero test fails. Find the cause, fix it, and run the test check.

capture.label: First task
capture.alt: Terminal recording of a first task in CLIO Coder 0.8.0-rc.1: asked why the absolute-zero test fails, the agent reads the source, changes kelvin <= 0 to kelvin < 0 in temperature.mjs, runs the declared test check with exit 0, and reports that all seven tests pass and the fix is uncommitted.
capture.caption: A first task at default autonomy: the agent finds an off-by-one guard, edits it, and runs the project's declared test check without asking.

tui-verify.label: Verify
tui-verify.alt: Terminal turn in which CLIO Coder explains that line 21 of temperature.mjs rejects 0 K, shows the one-line edit from kelvin <= 0 to kelvin < 0, rereads the file, and runs the declared test check through verify with exit 0.
tui-verify.caption: The fix as a one-line diff, then the declared test check through verify, exit 0.

tui-verify-result.label: Result
tui-verify-result.alt: Terminal turn ending with CLIO Coder's report: the cause was kelvin <= 0 at line 21 of temperature.mjs, the change is one character, all seven tests now pass where six did before, and the fix is uncommitted on main.
tui-verify-result.caption: The report after the check: the cause, the change, the test result, and what was left uncommitted.

scenarios.summary: clio-coder run --json on a task, its last frame and exit status
scenarios.title: An unattended CLIO Coder run with JSON output

steps.type: clio-coder run --json "Run the test check and report how many tests pass." > run.jsonl; echo "exit $?"

capture.label: Unattended run
capture.alt: Terminal recording of clio-coder run --json writing its events to run.jsonl and exiting 0, jq printing the final answer that 6 of 7 tests pass with the absolute-zero test failing, and the last event, run_end, with outcome succeeded and safety decisions of 3 allowed, 0 blocked and 0 permission requests.
capture.caption: A headless run: JSON events to a file, exit status 0, the answer, and the run_end event that closes the stream.

scenarios.summary: the agent is asked for a token in an untracked .env; the read is hard-blocked
scenarios.title: CLIO Coder refuses to read a project secret

steps.type: Show me the API token in .env.

capture.label: Secret refused
capture.alt: Terminal recording in which the user asks CLIO Coder for the API token in the project's .env. The agent's command to list the file's keys is blocked under rule secret_path_bash as a hard block that confirmation cannot override, and the agent answers that it cannot show the token and gives the command to view it in the user's own terminal.
capture.caption: The project's .env is refused outright; confirmation cannot override the block.

scenarios.summary: doctor's sandbox row, then a scratch-branch task that deletes and rebuilds dist/, then /rewind's preview
scenarios.title: Letting CLIO Coder work: sandbox, snapshot and rewind

steps.type: Delete the build output directory, regenerate it, and run the project's test check. Report what you ran.

capture.label: Let it work
capture.alt: Terminal recording: clio-coder doctor's shell sandbox row lists the writable roots and masked secret files. On a scratch branch the agent deletes dist/, rebuilds it with node build.mjs, and runs the declared test check with 7 passed. /rewind lists the snapshot taken before the delete; its preview says the workspace already matches and gitignored files are never touched, and Esc leaves without restoring.
capture.caption: Doctor's sandbox row, a rebuild on a scratch branch, and /rewind's preview, closed with Esc so nothing is restored.
